data.desc: OPI is a national REIT focused on owning and leasing office properties to high credit quality tenants in markets throughout the United States. As of September 30, 2026, approximately 62% of OPI's revenues were from investment grade rated tenants. OPI owned 109 properties as of September 30, 2026, with approximately 15.6 million square feet located in 27 states and Washington, D.C. OPI is managed by The RMR Group (Nasdaq: RMR), a leading U.S. alternative asset management company with approximately $37 billion in assets under management as of September 30, 2026, and 40 years of institutional experience in buying, selling, financing and operating commercial real estate. OPI is headquartered in Newton, MA. For more information, visit opireit.com.
